root_cause.text: In `dm-cache`’s `invalidate_complete()` error path, the code assumed `mg->cell` was always non-NULL and unconditionally passed it to `dm_cell_unlock_v2()`/`free_prison_cell()`, but in passthrough mode a concurrent write can cause prison cell allocation/lock failure so `mg->cell` remains NULL, leading to a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (mg->cell) { ... }` around `dm_cell_unlock_v2(cache->prison, mg->cell, &bios)` and `free_prison_cell(cache, mg->cell)`, and the CVE text states that “bio prison cell lock fails due to concurrent write ... mg->cell remains NULL” while “invalidate_complete() attempts to unlock and free the cell unconditionally, causing a NULL pointer dereference.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a null check before unlocking and freeing the migration cell in `invalidate_complete()` to avoid operating on a missing cell.
intent_record.what: The code now wraps the `dm_cell_unlock_v2(cache->prison, mg->cell, &bios)` call and the subsequent `free_prison_cell(cache, mg->cell)` in an `if (mg->cell)` null check inside `invalidate_complete()`, so those operations only run when `mg->cell` is non-NULL.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents `invalidate_complete()` from attempting to unlock or free a prison cell when `mg->cell` has not been set, avoiding invalid pointer use or a potential crash while leaving the existing success/error handling unchanged.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the root cause by guarding the invalidate_complete() error path against a NULL mg->cell before calling unlock/free helpers, preventing the NULL pointer dereference in passthrough mode.

candidates.rationale: This line unconditionally dereferences and passes mg->cell to dm_cell_unlock_v2() without checking for NULL. In the reported error path mg->cell can be NULL, so this is the direct NULL dereference trigger.
This line also uses mg->cell unconditionally. If mg->cell is NULL in the failing passthrough path, freeing it would operate on a missing cell and contribute to the NULL pointer dereference path.
